data.action: 明亮化妆镜前转椅上解开偶像礼服回眸微笑
data.description: 明亮专属化妆室的大面发光化妆镜前，星野爱坐在转椅上，解开偶像礼服拉链滑落至腰际，双眸中标志性的璀璨六芒星瞳闪烁着私密的娇羞与爱意，明亮环形柔光映衬着纤细锁骨、平坦小腹与迷人胸线。
data.lighting: 大面发光化妆镜的明亮环形柔光与化妆室通透漫射光
data.promptProse: Ai sits on the dressing-room swivel chair with her unzipped pink idol dress lowered to her waist, one hand at the zipper and the other on the armrest. She looks back with an embarrassed smile in the vanity mirror's bright ring-shaped soft light and the diffuse room light; the mirror faces away from the camera.
data.title: 星野爱 · 演出后后台化妆镜前
data.animaCaption: The mirror faces away from the camera beside her swivel chair.
